about: The Digitone II device Modwerk's builder carries, because the pinned Elekloader kit has none (owner, 19 November 2026): npm run machine:base registers it with the kit's Python SDK, and the site's builder with the browser kit (src/engine/elekloader/carried-devices.ts). The Digitakt II's platform with its own SysEx id, release and seal seed, the 256 KB DDR area and no SRAM code area (SRAM is not qualified on this OS): docs/DIGITONE_II_OS_RESEARCH.md. Numbers given as hex are strings.

device.name: Digitone II
device.recovery: hold FUNC while powering on for the STARTUP menu, press TRIG 4 (OS UPGRADE), then send the stock .syx over MIDI (not USB)
